about.title: Bhutan Taekwondo Federation
about.subtitle: The official national governing body of Taekwondo sport in the Kingdom of Bhutan.
about.visionDesc: To educate and guide Bhutanese youth through the core tenets of Taekwondo (Courtesy, Integrity, Perseverance, Self-Control, Indomitable Spirit), building physical fitness alongside leadership and moral character.
about.historyStep1: Official establishment of Bhutan Taekwondo Federation (BTF) and approval as an ATU member
about.historyStep2: Affiliation as a regular member of the Bhutan Olympic Committee (BOC)
about.historyStep3: Integration of Taekwondo into co-curricular activities across national schools
about.historyStep4: Partnership agreement signed for 'Project for Youth Development through Sports, Health, and Value Education in Bhutan' under KOICA support
about.execBoardMembers: 1 President, 2 Vice Presidents, 1 Secretary General, 7 Board Members
about.secretariatMembers: 1 Director at Thimphu HQ, 2 Administrative Assistants, 1 Treasurer
about.regionalDTAMembers: 10 Active Coaches dispatched to 10 Dzongkhag Taekwondo Associations
about.locationDesc: BTF Training Center & Administrative Headquarters Location

project.title: Project for Youth Development through Sports, Health, and Value Education in Bhutan
project.subtitle: An official ODA project focused on youth education and infrastructure in partnership with KOICA.
project.overviewDesc: Supported by the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA), this ODA project aims to foster the capacity of Bhutanese youth by integrating physical training (Taekwondo) with global health education and core value alignment. The project is managed by the Korea International Development Cooperation Center (KIDC) as the Project Management Consultant (PMC).
project.pillar1Desc: Physical training and self-esteem enhancement through nationwide school master dispatch
project.pillar2Desc: Developing and distributing guidelines for personal hygiene, disease prevention, and health education
project.pillar3Desc: Establishing civic norms and moral values rooted in the 5 core tenets of Taekwondo
project.milestonesSubtitle: Annual progress achievements and future project milestones roadmap.
project.centerDesc: Under construction in Thimphu, the Iconic Center serves as the primary hub for multi-purpose youth sports and educational training.

timeline.d2023: Established KOICA partnership, completed baseline survey on youth awareness, and approved Master dispatch plan.
timeline.d2024: Dispatched certified masters to 12 target schools, 1,087 students graduated the 1st cycle, and manuals reviewed.
timeline.t2025: Groundbreaking of Multi-purpose Gym in Thimphu
timeline.d2025: Secured land plot with KOICA assistance, hosting the groundbreaking ceremony of the Iconic Center specialized gym.
timeline.d2026: Following late 2026 opening, administrative and operational control will be fully transferred to BTF.

project.centerProgressDesc: Targeting completion by late 2026, framework concrete works are completed, and interior utility installations are actively ongoing.
project.use1: National championships, demonstrations, belt promotions, and joint training
project.use2: National team training, physiotherapy, and athletic fitness evaluation
project.room3: Youth Value & Health Seminar Rooms & BTF Headquarters
project.use3: Administrative offices, small-scale youth seminars, and value education

programs.title: Core Federation Programs
programs.subtitle: Key training and development programs run by BTF nationwide.

taekwondo.title: School Taekwondo Promotion Across 10 Dzongkhags
taekwondo.desc: Operating in partnership with 10 Dzongkhag Taekwondo Associations (DTAs), deploying certified masters to local schools and community centers for free training and official grading.
details: Scope: Public schools under 10 Dzongkhag Taekwondo Associations (DTA)
Benefits: Deploying certified masters for free training and donating equipment
Assessment: Hosting terminal belt promotional tests and awarding scholarships

health.title: Elite Athlete Development & International Games
health.desc: Cooperating with the Bhutan Olympic Committee (BOC) to train national youth athletes, supporting their participation in events like the Asian Games and Asian Youth Games.
details: Training: Regular training applying BOC athletic performance evaluation models
Key Goal: Securing medals in official international championships hosted by the Olympic Committee
Outreach: Participating in Royal celebrations and dispatching teams for global exchanges

value.title: Sports Science Coaching Certificate Seminars
value.desc: Conducting regular Sports Science Certificate Courses and technical safety workshops for regional coaches to build professional, secure local dojang infrastructure.
details: Subjects: Sports Science Course, first aid injury prevention, youth sports safety
Target: Active coaching masters and candidate junior assistants in DTAs
Expected Outcome: Obtaining international standards for coaching credentials and local dojang safety

defaultNotices.title: Success of the 2nd Ambassador Cup Taekwondo Championship
defaultNotices.content: Hosted by the Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Bangladesh, the championship concluded successfully in Thimphu with over 300 athletes showcasing spectacular skills.

defaultNotices.title: Schedule Announcement for Fall Integrated Belt Grading
defaultNotices.content: Official belt promotion tests will be conducted sequentially across 9 target zones from October. Regional masters, please submit application forms on time.

defaultNotices.title: Construction Framework Completion for Thimphu Iconic Center (65% Progress)
defaultNotices.content: The structural concrete work for the multi-purpose youth center has completed. The project remains on schedule for its official grand opening in late 2026.
